feed.title: ENTITY Project Updates
feed.subtitle: Release, economic fabric, qualification, developer and operator updates for ENTITY by Blackmore Technology Group Limited.

entry.title: ENTITY documentation now exposes the full digital-economic operating fabric
entry.summary: The public portal has been restructured so sovereignty is treated as an authority/recovery invariant rather than the definition of ENTITY. First-class documentation now covers venues, rights instruments, balances, listings, disclosures, order books, RFQs/quotes, call auctions, trades, clearing, entitlements, usage, surveillance, revenue rules, settlement verifiers, payment attestations, economic participation and market recovery.

entry.title: Vector and Memnox accepted external contributions recorded as ENTITY economic lineage
entry.summary: Vector issue #26501 / PR #26504 and Memnox issue #46 / PR #86 are both upstream merged and recorded as UPSTREAM_ACCEPTED_RECORDED. Both remain PRO_BONO with USD 0 realized cash and payment_settled=false. The cases demonstrate real external problem-to-contribution-to-acceptance-to-economic-state lineage without conflating acceptance with payment.

entry.title: ENTITY v3.4.3 — current supported remediation release
entry.summary: ENTITY v3.4.3 is the current supported runtime. The bounded remediation records 76/76 PASS for the Issue #28 remediation module and 279/279 PASS for the full source suite. BTDU remains component version 3.4.2 unchanged; v3.4.2 remains immutable historical evidence.

entry.title: Evaluate ENTITY for your organization
entry.summary: A plain-language evaluation path is available for enterprise architects, security teams, data and AI governance teams, market/data infrastructure teams and operators assessing authority, provenance, rights, evidence, economic state, recovery and provider portability.

entry.title: Six frozen ENTITY v3.4.2 reproduction tasks open for language-native contributors
entry.summary: Small reproducibility tasks remain open in Rust, TypeScript, C#/.NET, Go, Swift and Java against exact frozen v3.4.2 evidence targets where specified. These historical labels do not mean v3.4.2 remains the current runtime.

entry.title: ENTITY standards and interoperability pre-submission working draft
entry.summary: Open technical material for review of provider-neutral authority, provenance, rights, portable state and conformance boundaries. Current standards documentation also maps the market/economic interoperability surface without claiming standards-body endorsement.

entry.title: External v3.4.2 economic counterexample accepted for follow-up qualification
entry.summary: An outside reviewer identified a source-level evidence-substitution replay counterexample against the then-current v3.4.2 derivative-revenue behavior. BTG reproduced the boundary and v3.4.3 subsequently shipped the bounded remediation while preserving the immutable v3.4.2 evidence trail.

entry.title: ENTITY v3.4.2 — historical BTDU release
entry.summary: ENTITY v3.4.2 introduced the BTDU release line and remains immutable historical evidence. It is superseded for current deployment by ENTITY v3.4.3; the BTDU component itself remains version 3.4.2 unchanged.
